correctness.rationale: M_(2n) defined on Z/(2n) with cycle and antipodal edges except rung {0,n}; deletion-link mapping cone at vertex 0 for n=4k+1 and at 1 for n=4k+2. First deletion reduces by the cited unmodified-ladder vertex-deletion lemma to Ind(P_(6k+1)) contractible. Its link is folded via uniform open-neighborhood inclusion sequence to C_(6k), whose independence complex is two S^(2k-1). For n=4k+2, explicit fold sequences reduce the deletion to (n/2) disjoint K2 (hence S^(2k)) and link to (n/2-1)K2 (hence S^(2k-1)); attaching map vanishes because pi_(2k-1)(S^(2k))=0. Independently rebuilt cyclic-antipodal graph, verified every proposed neighborhood fold and final residues for k=1..13 in three cases; checked all r-exponents incl k=1. External standard path/cycle homotopy and one published vertex-deletion lemma are the only inputs beyond uniformly written graph folds.
